subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should CodexBar adopt this four-PR lineage ledger as the long-term shadow and eventual authority architecture, or prefer the narrower current-scanner fixes represented by https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118?
rationale: Both paths address fork-related overcounting, but this stack introduces roughly 6,200 lines of new accounting, discovery, diagnostics, promotion, and cache behavior; implementation correctness cannot decide whether that maintenance and product contract is desired.

options.title: Sponsor shadow architecture
options.body: Merge the four PRs in order after exact-head rebase and upgrade/rollback verification, while retaining legacy as the default and blocking authority promotion pending more finalized-day evidence.

options.title: Prefer narrow scanner repair
options.body: Prioritize https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118 and pause this stack until remaining errors demonstrate that a separate lineage architecture is necessary.

options.title: Decline the architecture
options.body: Keep the existing scanner model and close the lineage stack if its long-term complexity outweighs the additional diagnostic and promotion capabilities.

recommendation.title: Sponsor shadow architecture
recommendation.body: Merge the four PRs in order after exact-head rebase and upgrade/rollback verification, while retaining legacy as the default and blocking authority promotion pending more finalized-day evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available authority to choose the permanent accounting architecture and acceptable upgrade contract.
